answer: The delta test I would run is Gazetted railway signaller licence with railway authority attestation: a licence the authority renews after signal audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a licence the authority renews after signal audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the quartz is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the sparrow is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
